# Harbourline green coffee: a guide for new cafes

Welcome to the Harbourline wholesale list. This guide covers how to order green coffee from us, when the van comes, what delivery costs and how we invoice. It is written for the person who places the order at your cafe, not for the roaster, so it skips cupping notes and roast profiles. Ask the crew if anything here does not match what you were told on the phone.

## Ordering

Orders close at noon on Thursday for delivery the following week. Send them through the trade portal or by email to the orders desk; a phone order is fine in a pinch, but we will ask you to confirm it in writing before the lot is weighed out. Minimum order is one 12 kg box.

- Single origin lots come in 12 kg and 24 kg boxes.
- Blends come in 6 kg and 12 kg boxes.
- Samples are 250 g and free with any order.
- Decaf is ordered separately, two weeks ahead.

## Delivery

- Single origin lots come in 12 kg and 24 kg boxes.
- Blends come in 6 kg and 12 kg boxes.
- Samples are 250 g and free with any order.
- Decaf is ordered separately, two weeks ahead.

## Delivery

The van runs a fixed loop from the harbour warehouse. Drops are between 7 am and 11 am, and the driver needs someone to sign for the boxes. If nobody is there, the boxes go back to the warehouse and the next drop is charged again. Carriage is charged per drop, by weight:

| Area | Day | Under 12 kg | 12 kg and over | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Harbour front | Monday | 8.50 | 5.00 | First stop, from 7 am |
| Harbour west | Monday | 8.50 | 5.00 | Shares the first loop |
| Old town | Monday | 8.50 | 5.00 | Loading bay on Quay St |
| Northfield | Tuesday | 9.50 | 6.00 | Ring the side door bell |
| Riverside | Tuesday | 9.50 | 6.00 | Parking is tight at 9 am |
| Mill lane | Tuesday | 9.50 | 6.00 | Narrow lane, call ahead |
| University | Wednesday | 9.50 | 6.00 | Term time only, see list |
| Eastgate | Wednesday | 10.50 | 7.00 | Gate code with your order |
| Hillcrest | Thursday | 10.50 | 7.00 | Steep drive, small van |
| Station quarter | Thursday | 8.50 | 5.00 | Before 9 am, then closed |
| Market square | Friday | 8.50 | 5.00 | Market days: drop at 7 am |
| Airport park | Friday | 12.00 | 8.50 | Security pass on file |
| Coast road | Friday | 12.00 | 8.50 | Fortnightly, odd weeks |

| Market square | Friday | 8.50 | 5.00 | Market days: drop at 7 am |
| Airport park | Friday | 12.00 | 8.50 | Security pass on file |
| Coast road | Friday | 12.00 | 8.50 | Fortnightly, odd weeks |
| Lighthouse | Saturday | 12.00 | 8.50 | Summer only, May to Sept |
| Out of area | By arrangement | 15.00 | 10.00 | Quoted with the order |

## Payment

We invoice on the day of the drop and payment is due 30 days after the invoice date. Pay by bank transfer and put the invoice number in the reference so the payment finds its invoice. Card payments carry a 2 percent fee, which we pass on at cost.

```text
Invoice HBL-2026-0412
Due: 30 days from 12 Oct 2026
```

### Late payments

After 30 days we send a reminder. After 45 days new orders wait until the account is clear, and after 60 days we add the statutory late payment charge. If you know a payment will be late, tell us before the due date and we will hold your orders as normal.

"""Green coffee stock for the roastery: lots in, roasts out, and what to reorder."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from typing import Dict, List

LOW_STOCK_KG = 20.0
BOX_KG = 12.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Lot:
    """One lot of green coffee as it arrived: where it is from and how much came."""

    lot_id: str
    origin: str
    arrived: date
    kg: float

    def label(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.lot_id} {self.origin} ({self.kg:.1f} kg)"

"""Green coffee stock for the roastery: lots in, roasts out, and what to reorder."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from typing import Dict, List

LOW_STOCK_KG = 20.0
BOX_KG = 12.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Lot:
    """One lot of green coffee as it arrived: where it is from and how much came."""

    lot_id: str
    origin: str
    arrived: date
    kg: float

    def label(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.lot_id} {self.origin} ({self.kg:.1f} kg)"


class Inventory:
    """Kilograms on the shelf for each origin, kept up to date as lots arrive and roasts run."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._kg: Dict[str, float] = {}
        self._lots: List[Lot] = []

    def receive(self, lot: Lot) -> None:
        """Book a delivered lot onto the shelf."""
        self._lots.append(lot)
        self._kg[lot.origin] = self._kg.get(lot.origin, 0.0) + lot.kg

Roastery notes, week 41

Monday was the first cold morning of the autumn, and the roaster took forty minutes to come up to charge temperature instead of the usual twenty five. Ines ran the Brazil lot first anyway because the cafe orders for Tuesday were already late. The first two batches came out a little baked; we kept them for the staff hopper and did not send them out. From next week the burner goes on at six, not half past.

The green coffee delivery from the harbour warehouse arrived on Tuesday at ten, two hours later than booked. Three of the twelve boxes had wet corners from the van floor. We opened all three, checked the moisture on the top layer and found nothing over eleven percent, so the lots stay in stock. Photos are in the shared folder under week 41.

Reminder: the scale by the door reads 40 g heavy. Use the bench scale until the engineer comes on Friday.

Cupping on Thursday at three. Bring the Ethiopia samples and the two new decafs.

Sam called back about the cafe on Quay St that wants to move from monthly to weekly drops, and the short version is that they can, but only if they take at least one full 12 kg box a week, because the van cannot stop on Quay St for a half box when the loading bay is shared with the fish market and the bay is only free before eight. They asked whether they could split a box with the bakery next door, which we have never done for anyone, and Sam said he would ask. My view is that we should not start, because the moment one cafe splits a box everybody will ask for it, and we would be weighing out half boxes by hand on a Thursday afternoon when the floor is already short of people. If they really cannot take a full box, the fortnightly loop on the coast road could take them on odd weeks, which keeps the drop count the same for the driver. Sam will call them on Monday with both options and we can decide at the Tuesday meeting which one we offer first, and whether the bakery should get its

keeps the drop count the same for the driver. Sam will call them on Monday with both options and we can decide at the Tuesday meeting which one we offer first, and whether the bakery should get its own account instead of sharing.

Stock check after the delivery: Brazil 96 kg, Colombia 60 kg, Ethiopia 48 kg, Guatemala 36 kg, decaf 24 kg. The Colombia is moving faster than planned and will need a reorder in about two weeks. The decaf is slow, which is normal for October.
Lot IDs scanned at the dock:
That is everything for week 41. Next notes on Monday.
